proposed_comments.title: Isolate the Python protocol and terminate canceled child work
proposed_comments.body:
### Isolate the Python protocol and terminate canceled child work

**Severity:** `high`

The JSON result channel must remain valid even when user code, native extensions, subprocesses, or WSL login profiles write to stdout. Keep protocol output separate at the file-descriptor and WSL-shell levels, allow cancellation to escape clipboard extraction, terminate import probes and package installers on user cancellation, clamp persisted timeouts before converting to milliseconds, and reject package metadata that can be interpreted as pip command-line options.

proposed_comments.title: Use one syntax-aware discovery path without blocking the UI
proposed_comments.body:
### Use one syntax-aware discovery path without blocking the UI

**Severity:** `high`

Runtime and Settings discovery should agree on which top-level `advanced_paste_from_*_to_*` function a script defines. Use a shared lexical scanner that ignores comments, docstrings, and ordinary string literals correctly; use the same result for dependency detection; run directory enumeration and metadata reads on cancellable background work; and marshal only the resulting collection update to the UI thread.

proposed_comments.title: Make Python settings migration and trust persistence durable
proposed_comments.body:
### Make Python settings migration and trust persistence durable

**Severity:** `high`

Normalize null nested settings, script-action lists, hashes, modes, and timeout values during both runtime and Settings loads. Persist every legacy repair, preserve the legacy Windows/WSL folder preference even when scripts were disabled, treat unknown modes as disabled, and move trust-hash persistence off the UI thread so settings reload and trust confirmation cannot deadlock each other.

proposed_comments.title: Keep clipboard eligibility and execution payloads consistent
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep clipboard eligibility and execution payloads consistent

**Severity:** `high`

A script shown as eligible must receive the same formats at execution time. Restore the generic file flag for `StorageItems`, recognize image files copied from Explorer, carry file/audio/video paths consistently for Windows and WSL, snapshot the script tree before trust verification and execution, and read WSL JSON from an isolated output file rather than shell stdout.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve existing UI preferences and expose script metadata accessibly
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve existing UI preferences and expose script metadata accessibly

**Severity:** `medium`

Keep the persisted AI-prompt visibility preference and its Settings control, use the script description as the tooltip while retaining the path for execution, bound the combined custom-action and Python-script contribution to window height, and give every new icon-only browse/open button a localized UI Automation name and tooltip.

proposed_comments.title: Add deterministic regression coverage for parser and migration edge cases
proposed_comments.body:
### Add deterministic regression coverage for parser and migration edge cases

**Severity:** `medium`

Please cover multiline strings whose closing delimiter follows `#`, triple-quote text inside ordinary strings, dependency scanning, null nested migration, disabled WSL legacy migration, pip-option rejection, and Settings/runtime function-discovery parity. Keep the developer documentation accurate about timeout configuration and the named-function interface.

manual_test_instructions: In Settings, switch Python scripts among Off, Windows Python, and WSL Python; choose the scripts folder and interpreter; restart Settings and Advanced Paste and confirm the values persist.
Add named-function scripts for text, image, and files; verify names, descriptions, enabled state, and conversion summaries agree between Settings and the Advanced Paste window.
Run a script that prints from Python and from a child process and confirm the converted clipboard result remains valid JSON-backed output.
Copy one image file, multiple files, and audio/video files from Explorer; confirm eligible scripts receive the expected file_paths and dedicated media/image path.
Cancel import probes and package installation, exercise timeout behavior, and confirm no Python, pip, or WSL child process remains running.
Modify a trusted script during preparation and confirm execution fails closed; approve it again and confirm the new hash persists.
Use Narrator and keyboard navigation on the folder, interpreter, open-folder, and open-script buttons; verify the Advanced Paste window remains bounded on a 768-pixel-high display.
